title: Order intent
description: Written by nse-broker for every order the user approves (paper or live), in nse/intents/<date>-<fingerprint>.json and one line per intent in nse/intents/intents.jsonl. Broker-neutral: an external execution system (a risk governor, an OMS) can consume it, re-check it against its own rules, and place it. The consuming system owns the final decision; this file is a request, never an instruction to bypass that system's checks.

intent_id.description: <YYYY-MM-DD>-<16 hex fingerprint>; the same order on the same day has the same id, so a consumer can de-duplicate

created_ist.description: ISO time in India (+05:30) the user approved it

broker.description: the broker key from nse/config.json, e.g. shoonya

strategy.description: strategy name, run id and params hash when the order came from an nse-backtest signal

symbol.description: exchange symbol without series suffix, e.g. RELIANCE

max_loss_inr.description: loss at the stop including charges, as nse-budget sized it

typed_reply.description: the user's yes, word for word

algo_id.description: exchange Algo ID for API orders (SEBI retail-algo framework)
